x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given a spoke exists for the target system, When the integration is built, Then it uses the spoke action rather than a scripted REST call Given no spoke exists, When built, Then a reusable custom action with a connection alias is used
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: New and refactored integrations use IntegrationHub spokes / Flow Designer actions where available
